Page ABoxes as new files (1.3.0 for chapters 1 to 4, 1.1.0 for chapters 5 and 6); acceptance @ Courseware: web accessibility, model provenance, assessment rigour and Bloom coverage pass, the attestation is pending, not claimed. Stage 4 gates: coverage and substance fail and hybrid chains cannot run, as before; not claimed.

Grow.spec: Page template 9.13.0 and the pages of chapters 1 to 6 rebuilt on it: progress (mark a section understood, count in the title bar, ticks and dots in the explorer, a summary under Your data); a review queue (a wrong answer in the question builder or an exercise returns after 10 minutes, then 1, 3 and 7 days, through a Review button); a link for every section and tab, working back and forward buttons and a Copy link button; copy buttons beside code blocks and the Playground; a note for every concept; a print style and a Cheat sheet view; Yes / No / Report-an-error marks under every agent answer, copied out from Your data; Code exercises generated from the chapter's executed examples (put the lines in order, fill in a blank, make a program that raises an error run), each checked by running it. Resource lists for chapters 1 to 4 (14, 11, 14 and 14 links, each opened and read on 2026-09-30) and the chapter 3 Lecture tab from its deck's speaker notes (30 slides). sen0414_page_test_v9_13_0.py passed in headless Chromium on all six pages (91 to 94 checks each; no console errors; WCAG 2 AA clean); the stale-result fixture (every stored output altered) was run for all six. Page ABoxes as new files (1.4.0 for chapters 1 to 4, 1.2.0 for chapters 5 and 6); acceptance @ Courseware: web accessibility, model provenance, assessment rigour and Bloom coverage pass, the attestation is pending, not claimed. Stage 4 gates: coverage and substance fail and hybrid chains cannot run, as before; not claimed.
